meta.description: Mandatory Orientation Days for first-year students of the Wroclaw University of Economics and Business. 1–3 October 2026. Schedule, key links and answers in one place.

common.mandatoryFull: Attendance is mandatory for all first-year students of bachelor's, engineering and master's programmes - all fields of study, including English-language ones, in both full-time and part-time modes.

hero.title: Welcome to the Wroclaw University of Economics and Business!
hero.lead: Your academic adventure starts here. During Orientation Days you will get to know the campus, the people and everything worth knowing before your first classes.

home.socialLead: The most important announcements go out on Facebook. Join the events so you do not miss anything.
home.socialParty: FB event: UE Party x DA
home.docsLead: The rules of the event are described in the official regulations.
home.teamLead: Orientation Days are run by the UEW Student Union team. During the event you will recognise us by our T-shirts and badges.
home.aboutTeaser: A mandatory organisational and social event for first-year students. Over two days we will walk you through the campus, your rights and duties as a student, and the first integration party.

about.title: About Orientation Days
about.intro1: Orientation Days 2026 is a mandatory organisational and social event for first-year students of the Wroclaw University of Economics and Business. It takes place on 1–3 October 2026 on campus.
about.intro2: It is your first contact with the university after admission. We will show you how to find your way around campus, how your studies are organised and where to look for help before the semester begins.
about.legalBody: Orientation Days fulfil the statutory training on student rights and duties required by the Polish Law on Higher Education and Science. Every admitted first-year student must complete this training, and Orientation Days are how UEW delivers it.
about.modesHint: We will remember your choice, also on the schedule page.
about.sideBody: On Thursday, the integration part of Orientation Days takes place at the university's Zaprzegubie. You will be able to visit the stands of research clubs, student organisations and the Student Union, enjoy the prepared attractions and meet other students during the first get-together.
about.sideBody2: On Friday evening we host UE Party x DA - a party open to all first-year students, regardless of study mode or degree level. Details are in the schedule and in the Facebook event.
about.sideCta: UE Party x DA in the schedule

partners.title: Partners
partners.lead: Orientation Days are supported by the partners of the UEW Student Union.
partners.intro: Orientation Days are the first contact between several hundred first-year students and the university and the city of Wroclaw. Event partners reach them at a unique moment - the very start of student life.
partners.benefit1Body: Your brand is present where students make their first decisions - from a bank account to their favourite spots in the city.
partners.benefit2Body: Your logo, a stand and materials during the event, plus presence on this page throughout the admissions season.
partners.benefit3Body: You support the integration and a good start for hundreds of people, building a student-friendly brand image.
partners.ctaTitle: Become a partner of Orientation Days 2026
